# Human–AI Systems

> UK AI adoption consultancy founded and led by Mike McKeown. Its central offer is the Business AI Operating System: the AI platform an organisation already pays for, set up with a knowledge base, skills and agents, dashboards and connectors so it does real work for teams, with people checking anything that leaves the business. Human-AI Systems designs it with the client, builds it, trains their people in weekly learn-by-doing sessions and supports it afterwards, for one team or a whole organisation. Two routes: a bespoke build, or From Prompt to Autopilot, a fixed-price programme delivered with Third Circle. Around it sit discovery (Radar), pilots, scaling, governance and fractional AI leadership for larger organisations.

Key frameworks: Tool → Assistant → Worker (capability maturity; a Business AI Operating System is what makes the Worker stage practical); Radar → Pilot → Scale (the rollout route for larger organisations); Hybrid Workforce Leadership (leading teams where some work is done by AI).

Sectors: local government, financial services, professional services, SaaS and technology, small and mid-market organisations.
